name: lifepilot
description: A friendly daily planning app that turns messy tasks into a clear schedule.

scripts.postinstall:
node -e "console.log('
lifepilot is ready.

Try it in your terminal:
  lifepilot --demo
  lifepilot
')"
scripts.check: node --check src/planner.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check bin/lifepilot.js && node --check bin/postinstall.js && python -m py_compile lifepilot.py
